text:
18carat gold contains 75% gold and 25% copper by mass.
Which statements about 18carat gold are correct?
1
It is a mixture.
2
It is a compound.
3
It is an alloy.
4
It conducts electricity.
A
1, 2 and 4
B
1, 3 and 4
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3
subject: Chemistry
